title: Fan-in of program gates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\kappa$ be a type of instruction kinds, and let $\mathrm{prog}$ be a finite program of instructions of those kinds. For every natural number $i$, each gate in the circuit constructed from the first $i$ program steps has distinct input vertices, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and every gate has at most two inputs.
hypotheses_covered: A finite program of instructions of kinds in $\kappa$
